task.title: Updating system time using the system shell ()
task.shortdesc: If the commissioning process has not been completed yet, it is often important to set the current date and time.

keywords.indexterm: date and timeupdating using system shell

taskbody.prereq: You have connected to the controller using the system shell.

step.cmd: To access date and time, select system shell menu option 1 Update System Time .
step.stepresult:
The screen displays the following controller current date/time and clock synchronization information:
Local time
Universal time (UTC)
RTC (real time clock) time
Time zone
System clock synchronization status
NTP service status
RTC in local TZ (time zone) status (yes/no)
A prompt dispays, asking for new UTC date and time in the following format:
YYYY-MM-DD for year, month, and day
HH:MM:SS for hour, minute, and second

step.cmd: Enter date and time in the required format and press Enter to save the changes.
step.stepresult: If the the time information is successfully changed, a confirmation message appears on the screen.

step.cmd: Press Enter to return to the shell main menu.
